meta.name: deep-research
meta.description: Deep Research Agent for complex, multi-step research requiring web research, planning, and synthesis. Use instead of single web_search for any topic requiring multi-angle investigation. Trigger on: 'what is X', 'research X', 'compare X and Y', before content generation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成多角度网络调研并生成综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取多角度信息并整合成结构化内容
copy.tagline_en: Automate multi-angle web research and synthesize findings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to gather and synthesize information from multiple angles quickly

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先制定多步研究计划，然后分阶段搜索、阅读网页，提炼关键发现并保存到记忆，最后基于这些发现生成综合报告。
howto.when: 当你提出需要多角度调查的复杂问题，例如“什么是X”、“研究X”、“比较X和Y”，或在生成内容前需要深入研究时触发。

say.text: 研究一下2025年AI Agent架构的主要趋势。
say.note: Claude会执行多步搜索并生成综合报告。

say.text: 比较LangChain和CrewAI在Agent编排上的优缺点。
say.note: Claude会从多个角度搜索并对比。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first create a multi-step research plan, then search and read web pages in phases, distill key findings into memory, and finally generate a comprehensive report based on those findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask complex questions requiring multi-angle investigation, such as 'what is X', 'research X', 'compare X and Y', or before content generation tasks.

say_en.text: Research the main trends in AI agent architecture for 2025.
say_en.note: Claude will perform multi-step searches and produce a comprehensive report.

say_en.text: Compare LangChain and CrewAI for agent orchestration.
say_en.note: Claude will search from multiple angles and compare.
